WITH RECURSIVE b(sym, depth) AS (SELECT symbol, 0 FROM symbol WHERE kind = 'fn' AND file = 'tests/support/verify.rs' AND name IN ('verify','verify_without_dialogs','verify_without_framing','verify_without_runtime_dir','verify_in','verify_started','verify_without_screens','verify_program','verify_with','verify_runtime') UNION SELECT c.caller, b.depth + 1 FROM calls_m c JOIN b ON c.callee = b.sym WHERE b.depth < 4) SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.file, s.def_line + 1 AS line, min(b.depth) AS depth FROM b JOIN symbol s ON s.symbol = b.sym WHERE s.file NOT LIKE 'tests/support/%' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY s.file, line
